mods.name: Voxel 3D
mods.description: Rebuilds the overworld as a voxel diorama textured from the cartridge's own tileset, at the window's resolution, stages a battle on the map it was started on, and stands the opposing trainer behind their Pokemon. Press V to switch between it and the Game Boy Color view.

mods.name: Randomizer
mods.description: A run generated from a four-digit seed: what appears in the grass, base stats, types, movesets, evolutions, move power and accuracy, and every trainer's team. The same seed on the same cartridge is the same game, on anyone's machine. Each of the seven is its own setting.
